notes.title: New Ending - G-Space - Update 5
notes.notes:
New Ending
We have added the last ending and two new achievements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856099/f329a2dac6646102f8106c77cde69bf249b58c50.png
There is a special organization in the game with its agents and they created G-Space.

G-Space
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856099/c12ff71c6e8bfb9549aaadbcfcbab62359bd1612.png
The boy Curio can get there if the player fulfills the agents' conditions.
Once there, the agents will tell you what really happened.
This is a great reason to replay the game!
You will not only find new achievements, but also previously unknown plot details.

Improvement
-Added a warning at the beginning of the game.
-Changed the behavior of Miss Anomaly.
-Added a key plot sound in Chapter 1.
-Added the "Perfect Start" achievement and a unique dialogue at the end of the game.
-Added the "G-Space" achievement and an additional ending to the game.
-Simplified gameplay in Chapter 2.
-Added additional sounds for the monster's appearance in Chapter 2.
-Improved the localization of the settings menu.

Fixes
- Fixed a bug where the camera would incorrectly turn away when a monster appeared in Chapter 2.
- Fixed a bug with Perfect Pass that prevented the game from being completed.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
We are still collecting 10 reviews :D
BUT several respected curators played our game!
+ we received reviews on other gaming platforms and in Discord.

A lot of work has been done with controls and localization in this update.

Controls
The game uses many different mechanics that are very rare in games and the controls are not always convenient. We are still working on improving the control system, but thanks to the feedback we were able to make important changes that improved intuitiveness and usability.
List of improvements:

Hints during first use/interaction
Reassigned keys for the device with mini-games
Hints for direction and visual cues
Control of physical puzzles


Free AI Localization
Initially, the game was planned to have only 1 language, but now there are 10 (beta).
We decided to add a localization system to the game that allowed us to use artificial intelligence for accelerated translation, as well as give all interested players the opportunity to make edits to the translation if there are errors or downtime for modification.

And we managed to reduce 3430 translations by 10 times to 343.
You can learn more about this in the future devlog on Itch and in Discord.

 English
 French
 Spanish
 Українська
 German
 Polish
 Chinese
 Russian
 Japanese
 Corean

Translation may contain errors. We will release updates with corrections in the future.

Chapter 2
This chapter is a turning point in the entire game and it is in it that many unusual mechanics are implemented.
Changes:

Take the device with the [1], [2], [3], [4], [5] button instead of [E]
Hide the device with the [H] button instead of [E]
Now the "Chronology" journal opens with the [H] button and hide device
The monster now has an additional delay before it attacks
The music box no longer moves when using the bells
Added detailed instructions in all languages ​​during the tutorial at the beginning of the chapter
Messages that come to the device are now displayed in the Chronology in all languages


Other changes

Added a new anomaly
Increased the display time of some subtitles
Added visual elements in Chapter 1
Changed the background music in Chapter 1 to more intense
Changed the order of the anomaly corridors in the Introduction and Chapter 3
Added missing subtitles
Changed the order of events in the Timeline
Optimization of the Timeline menu (beta)
Added missing music in the Introduction and Chapter 3
Fixed the language reset error when completing the game

notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is our first Update!

Unfortunately, no one is interested in the game and we were unable to collect even 10 reviews...
But several people still left their review, which made us very happy!
Since we do not have any money for development, we cannot afford testing our game. Therefore, we rely entirely on player feedback when working on game updates

In this update:


 Loop corridors in Prologue have become more structured
 Some subtitles have become more structured (two lines instead of three)
 Main font has been replaced with a more readable one
 Tutorial for device mechanics in Chapter 2 (messages, mini-games)
 Tutorial for the monster mechanics in Chapter 2
 Updated tutorial for the puzzle box in Chapter 2
 Added visual hints for the puzzle box missing parts in Chapter 2


We look forward to your feedback, thank you!
